theorem_title: The power-initialization statement computes the exact power
theorem_formal_statement:
theorem ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.pow_spec {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) (a : ℤ) (μ : ℕ → ℤ) : ∀ κ : ℕ, ((n ^ κ : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ lim.word →
    _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.Ends lim P d (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.powStmt κ) ⟨_root_.Light.frame [a, n, 1], μ⟩ (4 * κ) (· = ⟨_root_.Light.frame [a, n, ((n ^ κ : ℕ) : ℤ)], μ⟩)
  := by sorry
theorem_natural_language_statement:
Let $n\ge1$, $a\in\mathbb Z$, and memory $\mu$ be arbitrary. For every exponent $\kappa$ with $n^\kappa$ fitting a word, the power statement transforms frame $[a,n,1]$ into $[a,n,n^\kappa]$ within $4\kappa$ light steps, leaving memory unchanged.
